'''Jon Manning Cloud City trooper deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jon Manning]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-23571">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23571 Cloud City trooper deck], DeckTech (jon "joker_phreak" manning, 25 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23571/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23571/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009140621/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23571/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jon Manning]]
* '''Published:''' 25 May 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Cloud City trooper deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Dining Room|CC-D-cloudcitydiningroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' people go to cloud city and kill other people while forcedraining and troopering against others

== Original post ==

'''Cloud City trooper deck'''
* '''Author:''' jon "joker_phreak" manning
* '''Published:''' May 25, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 2.5
* '''Description:''' people go to cloud city and kill other people while forcedraining and troopering against others

=== Strategy ===

Take over Cloud city and battle with the most people and their powers. Use character text to boost troopers and other characters and never quit fighting. making sure to get out Mr. Fett with starting interupt.
